summary: P1 1.5 Pass B1.1 -- adds a generation-safe inbound Remote Mic media-liveness fallback for the production path where GStreamer/libnice remains nominally connected after media stops. Established decoded media now arms a 2-second monotonic watchdog; expiry immediately mutes Remote Mic and reuses the existing configurable Reconnecting grace, while confirmed same-session media resumption recovers without treating a silent microphone as failed.
